summary: PLAT-103 shipped in PR #1 (mono, merged to main 472997126cd7f25eca254aac7cae3cca1a15a3b5; CI and CD green). Changes: validateApp now throws when owner is missing or empty (shared-contracts bumped 1.0.0 -> 2.0.0, breaking); core-shell passes owner 'platform', billing passes 'payments'. Assumptions: (1) sub-route-reports also calls validateApp, so it also passes owner, 'insights' from its package.json, otherwise it would throw at startup; (2) the owner is hardcoded in each app's source, matching the existing name argument, since the browser bundle cannot read package.json; (3) one PR for the ticket, since CONTRIBUTING prefers that and the contract change would break reports if merged alone; (4) shared-contracts is inlined, not published, so the 2.0.0 bump is the version record only. st audit reports 0 violations on main. Note: CD deploys are gated by DEPLOY_ENABLED in Jenkinsfile.cd; the CD result here was reported green by st.
